Dad: Which jobs did the five pupils do?
Eva: Leo designed the paper stand.
Dad: Did Jo take photos?
Eva: No, Jo wrote the instructions. Sam took the photos.
Dad: Who printed the guides?
Eva: Ruby printed them in the computer room after the teacher checked them.
Dad: And Alex?
Eva: Alex showed the models to visitors. He did not build the radio.
Dad: Was anyone choosing a password?
Eva: Not for this activity. Everyone had one of those five jobs.
